source.author: stat
source.text: aspice sacrilegas Cadmeae paelicis arces, siderei regina poli, tumulumque rebellem disice et in Thebas aliud potes excute fulmen.
source.text_original: 'aspice sacrilegas Cadmeae paelicis arces, / siderei regina poli, tumulumque rebellem / disice et in Thebas aliud — potes — excute fulmen.
source.text_english: Look upon the sacrilegious citadels of the Cadmean concubine, queen of the starry pole, and hurl down the rebellious tomb, and, if you can, shake another thunderbolt against Thebes.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: versam proles tua pandet Idumen namque potest : Solymo nigrantem pulvere fratrem spargentemque faces et in omni turre furentem.
reuse.text_original: versam proles tua pandet Idumen / (namque potest ): Solymo nigrantem pulvere fratrem / spargentemque faces et in omni turre furentem.
reuse.text_english: Your offspring will reveal Idumea turned over, for it can: the brother darkened with dust of Jerusalem, scattering torches and raging in every tower.
